nba_schedule.label: NBA.com — official schedule
nba_schedule.what: Fixture list, tip-off times (ET), venues, NBA Cup group tags, game IDs
nba_schedule.note: Tip-off times are ET as published by the league.

espn_odds.label: ESPN core odds endpoint (provider: DraftKings, id 100)
espn_odds.what: Consensus-listed spread, total, moneylines; both OPEN and CURRENT per game
espn_odds.note: Single-book (DraftKings) price snapshot relayed by ESPN. Not a market-wide consensus and not an NBA source.

nba_injury.label: NBA Official — Injury Report, 11/13/26 05:00 PM (PDF)
nba_injury.what: Game, team, player, participation status (Out/Doubtful/Questionable/Probable/Available), reason
nba_injury.note: Timestamped snapshot issued by the league. Superseded by later same-day reports.

nba_injury_index.what: Filing rules (5 p.m. local the day before; 1 p.m. for 2nd of back-to-back) and the index of every dated report
nba_injury_index.note: Establishes the reporting obligation, not any player's health.

game_preview.label: NBA.com game preview, NYK vs IND, Nov 13 2026 (Field Level Media)
game_preview.note: League-operated page, but the season averages are editorial copy, not a stats export.

bbr_leaders.label: Basketball-Reference — 2026-27 PPG/RPG/APG leaders strip
bbr_leaders.note: Displayed as Doncic 38.6 PPG, Towns 13.5 RPG, Jokic 9.0 APG on 2026-11-13.

hca_points.label: Home-court advantage, points
hca_points.why: Fixed league-wide constant used to convert neutral ratings into a home/road matchup.
hca_points.status: ASSUMPTION — not estimated from this season's data
hca_points.sensitivity: Every originated spread shifts 1:1 with this constant. See the sensitivity table on methodology.html.

sd_margin.label: Standard deviation of game margin, points
sd_margin.why: Gaussian margin model for cover probabilities.
sd_margin.status: ASSUMPTION — calibrated to a typical NBA margin sd; not re-estimated here
sd_margin.sensitivity: Cover probability is highly sensitive near the line; see sensitivity table.

sd_total.label: Standard deviation of game total, points
sd_total.why: Gaussian total model for over/under probabilities.
sd_total.status: ASSUMPTION — calibrated to a typical NBA total sd; not re-estimated here
sd_total.sensitivity: Over/under probability moves ~2.7 points of probability per total point near the mean.

shrink_k.label: Regression-to-mean constant (games)
shrink_k.why: Prior games of league-average performance mixed into each team rating: r_adj = (G*r + k*0)/ (G+k).
shrink_k.sensitivity: Larger k pulls ratings toward average and toward the market.

constants.note: Measured from the 86 completed games transcribed for 2026-11-01..11-12. Margin sd and total sd are used as the Gaussian scales; se/CI are shown so the reader can see how thin the sample is.

pick_screen.self_check: Every modelled signal came out positive-EV against one book. That is not evidence of 20 bets worth taking; it is evidence that a model which ignores injuries will disagree with a market that prices them. The screens above exist to throw most of those disagreements away.

prop_inventory.note: 1,170 individual prop price points exposed for NYK@IND. Market type ids observed start at type id 1 = 'Total Points'. Athlete names are returned as opaque ids; name resolution was NOT completed in this session, so no prop price is presented as belonging to a named player.

correlation.interpretation: Positive: both teams' scoring is driven by a shared possession count, so opposing totals move together. This is the mechanism behind same-game total correlation.
Near zero means spread and total legs in the same game are close to independent, so a spread+total parlay can be multiplied with little error.
Average within-team correlation across 29 teams with >=5 games. Catches pace-driven teams that inflate both sides.
correlation.note: Mean of per-team Pearson r. Not a population CI.

backtest_summary.caveat: In-sample diagnostic. Ratings cover the same window as the games being scored, so this overstates any real edge. It is published to show the arithmetic is internally consistent, not as a performance claim.

strategies.name: Favourite-side spread (model vs market)
strategies.thesis: Where the originated spread differs from the listed spread, take the side the model favours. Edge is measured in points and converted to probability with the measured margin distribution.
strategies.stake_rule: flat 1 unit; no progression, no chase

evidence.sample_unit: games with a captured market line (2026-11-13 slate only)
evidence.note: No historical closing line exists in this session, so S1 cannot be scored on returns. Only a present-tense signal count is shown.

gates.name: Data provenance
gates.evidence: Ratings: Basketball-Reference advanced table. Prices: ESPN core odds endpoint (DraftKings). Both transcribed with URL and retrieval time.

gates.name: Leakage prevention
gates.evidence: Ratings are measured through 2026-11-12 and the market prices are a 2026-11-13 snapshot, so the comparison is live-clean. But no historical price archive exists, which means the strategy cannot be tested without look-ahead.

gates.name: Baseline & calibration
gates.evidence: No scored sample of S1 signals exists, so no calibration plot can be produced.

gates.name: Robustness
gates.evidence: Sample of 9 live games. Power is far below the required n.

gates.name: Dependence (combos)
gates.evidence: If combined, spread legs across games are near-independent; the measured margin/total correlation is reported on the correlation page.

gates.name: Economic test
gates.evidence: No closing-line history and no settlement archive.

gates.name: Prospective monitoring
gates.evidence: Signal must be frozen, logged pre-tip, and scored after settlement.

strategies.name: Total vs market (pace/ratings divergence)
strategies.thesis: Originated total = league average scoring scaled by the two teams' expected possessions. Divergence from the listed total is the signal.

evidence.note: Directional signal only; no historical totals archive.

gates.name: Dependence (combos)
gates.evidence: Measured margin vs total correlation documented; over legs in different games are weakly dependent through pace only.

strategies.name: Moneyline value on the dog
strategies.thesis: Devig the two-way moneyline, compare the de-vigged implied probability with the model's win probability, and only act when the model is higher by more than the measured noise floor.
strategies.stake_rule: flat 1 unit; quarter-Kelly cap as an upper bound only

evidence.note: Only the 2026-11-13 slate carried prices this session.

gates.name: Data provenance
gates.evidence: ESPN core odds endpoint, both moneylines, vig reported per game.

strategies.name: Win-probability calibration (scored)
strategies.thesis: Emit a win probability for every completed game and score it with a proper rule. This is the one strategy in this build with a real, computed score, because it needs no price history.
strategies.stake_rule: n/a — scored on Brier and calibration, not staked

evidence.note: In-sample: ratings overlap the scored window, so treat as a consistency check.

gates.name: Data provenance
gates.evidence: All 86 game results transcribed with the source page.

gates.name: Leakage prevention
gates.evidence: In-sample by construction; no earlier-season ratings available this session.

gates.name: Robustness
gates.evidence: n=86; a single 12-day window in one season.

gates.name: Dependence (combos)
gates.evidence: Forecast scoring, no legs to combine.

gates.name: Prospective monitoring
gates.evidence: Requires frozen snapshot scoring going forward.

strategies.name: Cross-game parlay (independent legs)
strategies.thesis: Multiply de-vigged leg probabilities across games only where measured correlation is indistinguishable from zero, then compare with the offered parlay price.
strategies.stake_rule: flat, small; cap at 2 legs until G2 and G6 pass

evidence.note: No parlay price was captured. Leg independence IS measured: see the correlation page.

gates.name: Data provenance
gates.evidence: Leg prices exist for 9 games; parlay prices do not.

gates.name: Dependence (combos)
gates.evidence: Margin-vs-total r and away-vs-home total r measured with 95% CI on 86 games.

gates.name: Economic test
gates.evidence: Parlay price and settlement rules not captured.

strategies.name: Same-game player prop combo
strategies.thesis: Legs on the same game share minutes, usage and score state. The joint probability must be estimated directly, never by multiplying marginals.

evidence.note: Blocked: no minutes distribution and no per-player game logs were retrieved.

gates.name: Data provenance
gates.evidence: 1,170 prop price points are exposed for one game, but athlete names needed 1 lookup each and only 5 were resolved.

gates.name: Dependence (combos)

gates.name: Prospective monitoring
